desktop.renderer: Two-pass raster with numerically fitted finite-area GGX lighting, new procedural geometry, baked visibility/indirect light, analytic solid-lens/crystal interfaces with static scene-local radiance captures

antialiasing.type: Native-pixel spatial resolve; eight subpixel-jittered raster views while stationary only, one RGB8 history; no MSAA or path tracing

surfaceMaps.normalEncoding: tangent XYZ mapped 0..1; AO in alpha
surfaceMaps.source: Authored deterministic grain, fracture, bark-plate and leaf-venation maps. Not photographed or scanned.

flameVolume.source: Offline buoyancy/advection/pressure-projection flow, heat and fuel; simplified combustion. Six-volume crossfade closes the presentation loop. Not a validated fire solver.
flameVolume.presentation: Volume stretched vertically into the exhibit and translated to the burner; turbulent sub-grid shading is artistic, not resolved combustion.

areaLighting.source: Deterministic numerical fit of isotropic GGX to transformed cosine densities, generated by fit_area_lights.py; mathematical lookup data, not imagery.

opticalCaptures.source: Actual opaque-geometry browser captures at the optical centers, including the optical mounts; analytic glass itself is absent from the opaque pass; box-filtered mips. Scene-local fallback for off-screen refraction/reflection, not a photograph or scan.

desktop.geometrySource: Dimensioned optomechanics, closed-thickness compressor airfoils, supported bearings, cut material specimens, coherent fractured geology, hierarchical procedural pine, refractory crucible and calibrated central instrument. All assets generated by the included code; no scans or image-derived geometry.
limitations: Assets have been reconstructed, but remain authored procedural assets, not photographs or scans.
Static illumination and reflection captures; cached glass cannot track moving occluded geometry.
No MSAA, depth-of-field or path-traced refinement in this live build.
GPU memory figures are format-sized estimates, not driver memory measurements.
Physical Adreno performance and stability have not been verified by the build environment.
